cases.translation: In the Lord I find refuge
cases.explain: Приют is the direct object of нахожу (I find), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: нечестивые, уже натянули ___, положили стрелу на тетиву
cases.translation: the wicked have already strung their bow
cases.explain: Лук is the direct object of натянули (have strung), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда устои распались, что может сделать ___?
cases.translation: When the foundations are shaken, what can the righteous person do?
cases.explain: Праведный is the subject of может сделать (can do), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Господь в святом ___ своем, Господь на небесном троне своем
cases.translation: The Lord is in His holy temple, the Lord is on His heavenly throne
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Он наблюдает за всем, глаза его испытывают ___
cases.translation: He observes all, His eyes examine mortals
cases.explain: Смертных is the direct object of испытывают (examine), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господь испытывает праведных, а нечестивых и тех, кто любит насилие, ненавидит его ___
cases.translation: The Lord tests the righteous; the wicked and those who love violence His soul hates
cases.explain: Душа is the subject performing the action ненавидит (hates), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он на нечестивых прольет дождем раскаленные угли с горящей ___
cases.translation: Upon the wicked He will rain down burning coals and brimstone
cases.explain: The word с (with) takes the instrumental case when expressing accompaniment.

cases.translation: The Lord is righteous and loves just judgment
cases.explain: Суд is the direct object of любит (loves), taking the accusative case.

reading.question: Where does the psalmist find refuge?
reading.explain: The psalmist declares В Господе я нахожу приют (In the Lord I find refuge).

reading.ru: Вот, нечестивые, уже натянули лук, положили стрелу на тетиву, чтобы во тьме стрелять в правых сердцем.
reading.question: What are the wicked preparing to do?
options: Shoot arrows at the righteous in the darkness
reading.correct: Shoot arrows at the righteous in the darkness
reading.explain: The text describes как натянули лук, положили стрелу на тетиву, чтобы во тьме стрелять (they have strung their bow, fitted the arrow to the bowstring, to shoot in the darkness).

reading.ru: Когда устои распались, что может сделать праведный?
reading.question: What question is asked about the righteous person when foundations are shaken?
options: What can the righteous do when the foundations collapse?
Why is the world still standing?
reading.correct: What can the righteous do when the foundations collapse?
reading.explain: The psalmist asks Когда устои распались, что может сделать праведный? (When the foundations are shaken, what can the righteous do?)

reading.ru: Господь в святом храме своем, Господь на небесном троне своем.
reading.question: Where is the Lord according to this verse?
options: In His holy temple and on His heavenly throne
reading.correct: In His holy temple and on His heavenly throne
reading.explain: The text states Господь в святом храме своем, Господь на небесном троне своем (The Lord is in His holy temple, the Lord is on His heavenly throne).

reading.ru: Он наблюдает за всем, глаза его испытывают смертных.
reading.question: What does God do according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text says Он наблюдает за всем, глаза его испытывают смертных (He observes all; His eyes examine mortals).

reading.question: What privilege do the righteous have?
options: They will be punished by God
They will be forgotten by God
reading.explain: The text promises Праведники увидят его лицо (The righteous will see His face).
